title: HellaSwag-Pro: A Large-Scale Bilingual Benchmark for Evaluating the Robustness of LLMs in Commonsense Reasoning
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the robustness of large language models in bilingual (English and Chinese) commonsense reasoning across various daily life scenarios such as household chores, traffic, and education. It does not investigate or benchmark religion, faith, theology, or specific ethical/moral systems.
